title: Jeff Ulbrich: New Browns DC Mike Rutenberg one of the best teachers in the NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jeff Ulbrich: New Browns DC Mike Rutenberg one of the best teachers in the NFL
sources.description: The Browns hired Mike Rutenberg as their defensive coordinator this week and Rutenberg got a rave review from Falcons defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich on his way out the door in Atlanta.
